q.en: What building materials and hardware do you sell?
q.sw: Mnauza vifaa gani vya ujenzi na hardware?

a.en: We supply a full range of building materials and hardware in Tanzania, including cement and aggregates, steel and rebar, roofing sheets (mabati), plumbing, electrical, paint and finishing, and tools.
a.sw: Tunasambaza vifaa vyote vya ujenzi na hardware Tanzania: saruji na kokoto, chuma na nondo, mabati, mabomba, umeme, rangi, na zana.

q.en: Where are you located and which areas do you deliver to?
q.sw: Mko wapi na mnasambaza maeneo gani?

a.en: We are based in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, and deliver building materials across the country, including Dodoma, Arusha and Mwanza.
a.sw: Tuko Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, na tunasambaza vifaa vya ujenzi nchini kote, ikiwemo Dodoma, Arusha na Mwanza.

q.en: Do you offer wholesale prices for contractors?
q.sw: Mnatoa bei za jumla kwa wakandarasi?

a.en: Yes. We offer competitive wholesale pricing for contractors, builders and large projects. Contact us on WhatsApp for a quote.
a.sw: Ndiyo. Tunatoa bei nafuu za jumla kwa wakandarasi, wajenzi na miradi mikubwa. Wasiliana nasi kwa WhatsApp kupata bei.

q.en: How can I get a price quote or place an order?
q.sw: Nawezaje kupata bei au kuweka oda?

a.en: The fastest way is to message us on WhatsApp or call us directly. You can also email us and we will respond quickly.
a.sw: Njia ya haraka ni kututumia ujumbe kwa WhatsApp au kutupigia simu. Pia unaweza kutuma barua pepe na tutajibu haraka.

q.sw: Saa zenu za kazi ni zipi?

a.en: We are open Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
a.sw: Tuko wazi Jumatatu hadi Jumamosi, saa 2 asubuhi hadi saa 12 jioni.

q.en: Are your products genuine and good quality?
q.sw: Bidhaa zenu ni halisi na za ubora?

a.en: Yes. We stock only genuine, quality-checked building materials from trusted brands so your project lasts.
a.sw: Ndiyo. Tunahifadhi vifaa halisi vilivyokaguliwa ubora kutoka kwa chapa za kuaminika ili mradi wako udumu.
